create_CTRLConfig: create a CTRLConfig instance for initializing a Salesforce CTRL model with default hyperparameters
configure_CTRL_model: configure a CTRL model by instantiating CTRLConfig with custom vocab_size, n_positions, n_embd, and n_layer values
initialize_CTRL_from_config: initialize a CTRLModel from a pre-configured CTRLConfig instance with specified attention heads and hidden size
access_CTRL_config: access the model configuration from a loaded CTRLModel instance via the config attribute
customize_CTRL_embeddings: customize CTRLConfig with custom pad_token_id, bos_token_id, eos_token_id, and tie_word_embeddings settings
